title: Mulan
tagline: One soldier. One dragon. Plenty of dumplings.
about: A young woman disguises herself as a man to take her father's place in the army.

    StartersMatchmaker's tea and dumplingsSteamed pork dumplings with garlic chives and ginger, soy and black vinegarHow to make it400g pork mince1 bunch garlic chives, chopped1 tbsp grated ginger30 dumpling wrappers4 tbsp soy sauce2 tbsp Chinkiang vinegarMix the pork, garlic chives and ginger.Fill the dumpling wrappers and pleat.Steam for 8 minutes.Serve with soy and Chinkiang vinegar, and pour the tea carefully.Cri-Kee's lucky vegetable spring rollsCrisp rolls of cabbage, shiitake, carrot and glass noodles with sweet chilliHow to make it100g rice vermicelli1/4 wombok, finely shredded2 carrots, grated150g shiitake mushrooms, sliced1 bunch garlic chives2 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp sesame oil20 spring rolls of wrappers1 tbsp cornflour1 L vegetable oil, for frying125ml sweet chilli sauceSoak the vermicelli in hot water 5 minutes, drain and snip into short lengths.Stir-fry the wombok, carrot and mushrooms in a splash of the oil until wilted, then add the chopped garlic chives, soy and sesame oil.Toss with the noodles and cool completely.Mix the cornflour with a little water. Roll a spoonful of filling tightly in each wrapper, folding in the sides, and seal with the paste.Heat the oil to 180°C and fry the rolls in batches until golden. Drain and serve with sweet chilli sauce.Training camp edamameFor Yao, Ling and Chien-Po. Wok tossed with garlic, chilli and soyHow to make it500g frozen edamame2 garlic cloves, sliced1 tsp chilli flakes1 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp flaky saltSteam the edamame for 4 minutes.Toss in a hot wok with the garlic, chilli flakes and a splash of soy.Finish with plenty of flaky salt and serve in a big bowl.Spring onion pancakes with chilli oilFuel for the climb up the pole.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsMushu's breakfast congeeGinger rice porridge, egg and bacon, happy to see you.How to make it200g jasmine rice2 L chicken stock1 piece ginger, sliced4 eggs8 rashers of bacon3 spring onions, sliced2 tbsp soy sauceSimmer the rice in the stock with the ginger for 90 minutes, stirring often, until silky.Fry the eggs and bacon.Top each bowl with an egg and bacon smile, spring onion and soy.Imperial City red-braised chickenChicken thighs braised glossy in soy, star anise and rock sugar, bok choy and riceHow to make it8 chicken thigh fillets, in large pieces3 tbsp light soy sauce2 tbsp dark soy sauce3 tbsp chicken stock40g rock sugar or brown sugar4 slices of ginger4 spring onions2 star anises1 cinnamon stick1 tbsp vegetable oil4 baby bok choys300g jasmine riceBrown the chicken in the oil in a wide pan.Add the ginger, spring onion pieces, star anise and cinnamon, then the soy sauces, stock, sugar and 250 ml water. Simmer covered for 20 minutes.Uncover and simmer, turning the chicken, until the sauce is glossy and sticky.Cook the rice and steam the halved bok choy for 3 minutes.Serve the chicken and sauce with the rice and bok choy.SweetsGrandmother Fa's lotus mooncakesGolden baked pastry filled with sweet lotus seed pasteHow to make it100g golden syrup30ml vegetable oil1 tsp alkaline water150g plain flour400g lotus seed paste1 egg, beatenMix the golden syrup, oil and alkaline water, then the flour into a dough.Rest the dough for 2 hours.Divide the paste into balls and wrap thin portions of dough around each. Press into moulds.Bake at 180°C for 10 minutes, egg wash, then bake 10 minutes more.DrinksFamily temple iced jasmine lychee teaPoured for the ancestors in the family temple. Jasmine tea, lychee syrupHow to make it4 bags of jasmine green tea1 L water1 tin lychees, 565g, drained with syrup kept1 lime, juiced12 mint leaves2 cups iceSteep the tea bags in water at 80°C for 3 minutes, remove and chill.Stir some of the lychee syrup and the lime juice into the cold tea.Pour over ice in glasses with lychees and a few mint leaves.Osmanthus honey sodaLittle Brother runs for it, every time.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
